occurrences.finding: Requirement of Gas Leak Inspection: The gas leak inspection was last completed on 4/25/2024 and is past due for a new one.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirement of Gas Leak Inspection (26 TAC §746.5401)

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training - More than 5 years experience: The director owes 3 hours training in management/ supervision/ leadership.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training - More than 5 years experience (26 TAC §746.1311(f)(2))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: 1 out of 4 children's files is missing the immunization record.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional: 1 child wtih a diagnosed food allergy wtih a plan had an expired epi-pen in storage and missing the Benadryl.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §746.3819)

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: 1 out of 6 children's files was missing an immunization record.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Vision and Hearing Screening (26 TAC §746.603(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: A review of the Employees Who Left Employment in 2024 data from January 17, 2025, revealed that the center had not reported the number of employees who left employment in 2024 by January 15, 2025, as required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired: A wooden gazebo in the children's outdoor playspace has rotten boards and needs to be repaired, removed or replaced.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired (26 TAC §746.4751(c))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Conducted by Fire Marshal: The center's last fire inspection expired on 6/27/24 and needs updating.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Conducted by Fire Marshal (26 TAC §746.5101(b))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Keep Records for 3 Months: The center needs to document daily/ monthly checks utilizing the building and grounds checklist and maintain the record for three months and made available to Licensing.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Keep Records for 3 Months (26 TAC §746.4751(d))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times: The television was on while kids were napping.         The director did turn off the television.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(4))

occurrences.finding: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games: The director and caregiver was watching tv and on their personal cell phones.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games (26 TAC §746.1203(3)(D))

occurrences.finding: Director Responsibilities - Employees Comply with Standards: The director is not ensuring that employees are following  minimum standards when allowing caregivers on their personal phones and watching tv.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Responsibilities - Employees Comply with Standards (26 TAC §746.1003(2))

occurrences.finding: Arrangement of Napping Equipment -All Children Supervised: The children were sleeping in the classroom next door, the director was sitting in the door way with her back  turn to the children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Arrangement of Napping Equipment -All Children Supervised (26 TAC §746.2909(5))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))
